candidates._why: One axis from the recorded MARGIN 60 run: DIODE_TRIM_KEEP 2 with DIODE_TRIM_MIN_DIODES 6 (the setting that left only the weak one-sink driver at 75). The recorded failures at this margin are mid-size drivers loaded with 6 to 15 diodes, which the trim reaches. Predicts those fanout, slew and capacitance failures clear and the antenna count stays at or below the recorded value; falsified if a diode-loaded net still fails or antenna rises above it. Signoff-clean against hul (6 antenna, 0 elsewhere) is the bar.
